classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied altitude to calculate sloping sides and base portions with sine and tangent, then assemble only the outer lengths into the perimeter.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of this triangle. Answer to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base, left base angle 60 degrees, right base angle 25 degrees and a red dashed altitude of 20 m.
spec.mathematics: The altitude divides the triangle into two right triangles with common opposite side 20 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; auxiliary vertex and foot names are omitted.

answer.worked:
Let $F$ be the foot of the altitude, $T$ the apex, and $L$ and $R$ the base endpoints.
$$\begin{align*}
LT&=\frac{20}{\sin60^\circ}\\
TR&=\frac{20}{\sin25^\circ}\\
LF&=\frac{20}{\tan60^\circ}\\
FR&=\frac{20}{\tan25^\circ}\\
P&=\frac{20}{\sin60^\circ}+\frac{20}{\sin25^\circ}+\frac{20}{\tan60^\circ}+\frac{20}{\tan25^\circ}\\
P&\approx124.86\text{ m}
\end{align*}$$
